newsitem.title: USA: Global Med wins FDA nod for SAFETRACE.
newsitem.headline: Global Med wins FDA nod for SAFETRACE.

text.p: Global Med Technologies, Inc said in a statement that its Wyndgate Technologies unit had been notified by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration of the agency's finding of "substantial equivalence" for its SAFETRACE blood management information system.
"This determination allows the company to continue to market the SAFETRACE blood center management information system," the medical information technology company said.
The company said that it had 24 contracts in place for the system. ((--New York Newsroom 212 859 1700))
